???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do braces with statements inside form, and what does each one create?"

        A block. Every block creates a new scope, so a variable declared inside it cannot be used after the closing brace.

        Introduced in [6. Statements](09-statements.md). Specification: [6. Statements and control flow](../specification/statements.md#62-blocks).

    ??? question "What is `square(4.0)` an example of, and what happens when it runs?"

        A function call. The function's body runs, then execution carries on from just after the call.

        Introduced in [5. Expressions](08-expressions.md). Specification: [5. Expressions](../specification/expressions.md#calls).

    ??? question "What do you declare to group related values into a new named type, such as `Point` with `x` and `y`?"

        A struct. Declaring it creates a type; a struct expression creates a value of that type.

        Introduced in [4. Variables and types](04-variables-and-types.md). Specification: [8. Structs](../specification/structs.md#81-declaration).

    ??? question "What tells the compiler what kind of value something is and what can be done with it?"

        Its type. Every Vortex expression has exactly one type, known before the program runs.

        Introduced in [4. Variables and types](04-variables-and-types.md). Specification: [4. Types and values](../specification/types-and-values.md).

    ??? question "What do we call a name the programmer chose, such as `width` or `Point`?"

        An identifier. It starts with a letter or `_`, continues with letters, digits or `_`, and is case-sensitive.

        Introduced in [2. Basic source rules](02-basic-source-rules.md). Specification: [2. Lexical structure](../specification/lexical-structure.md#23-identifiers).
